title: In-car tech and setup
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on in-car technology and setup, with praise for the overall quality and driving tech but many fragments too vague to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the in-car tech as impressive, very good, and a strong part of the driving experience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention frustration with the tech and dissatisfaction with specific setup behavior such as the locking configuration for two drivers.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention tech, touchiness, or a learning curve without enough detail to classify the experience as positive or negative.

limitations: Nearly half of the topic's reviews are undetermined, so the examples do not consistently show clear attitudes toward the technology.
Several fragments are extremely brief or incomplete, limiting confidence about which specific tech features or setup elements are being discussed.
The topic centers on technology and setup, but the sampled fragments do not provide enough detail to identify consistent subfeatures beyond general in-car tech and one locking/setup example.
